characters.name: Mallow
lines: Your fins look tired. I saved you the soft side.
This quilt has a pocket for especially little dreams.
Shh. The blanket is practising being a cloud.

characters.name: Tilly
lines: I counted the eggs twice. They keep looking rounder.
Would you like to help me wish them a good morning?
One day they will be brave little swimmers too.

characters.name: Posy
lines: I grew this bouquet for whoever needed a little hello.
The shy flowers open when somebody is kind.
No occasion needed. Tuesdays are quite enough.

characters.name: Purl
lines: A scarf for a mermaid? Let me measure your tail.
I dropped a stitch. Posy planted it.
It is a very long scarf. The sea is quite draughty.

characters.name: Ludo
lines: I light the little lamps so nobody feels lost.
This one is for anyone taking the long way home.
Vesper says the dark is just a book before you open it.

characters.name: Vesper
lines: Welcome to the library. Every story has a happy shallows.
Please return your dreams whenever you have new ones.
I keep the quiet stories on the softest shelf.

characters.name: Peep
lines: A bubble tart? It is mostly air, but lovingly prepared.
Please mind the crumbs. They have learned to swim.
Saffron grew the blueberries. I did the important puffing.

characters.name: Saffron
lines: Every tiny leaf gets its very own good morning.
Peep thinks this is a pastry garden. I let him.
Your wake gave the flowers a lovely little dance.

characters.name: Button
lines: Have you lost a button? I found an excellent blue one.
Eight arms. One button. Somehow still behind schedule.
I make pockets for things too small to explain.

characters.name: Hush
lines: A little rain is lovely when it knows where to fall.
Button made my umbrella. I made the weather.
You can rest here. This cloud only rains lullabies.

characters.name: Sir Crumb
lines: A cup for Sarah. I have warmed the handle.
Please excuse the biscuit. It insists on being formal.
Dot says crumbs are simply very small celebrations.

characters.name: Dot
lines: One pearl for a smile. That is the entire dress code.
Sir Crumb asked me to mend a biscuit. I embroidered it.
Every little imperfect pearl belongs somewhere.

characters.name: Miri
lines: A little room for a very grand rehearsal!
Oona is our audience. She applauds in her sleep.
Ready? One, two… oh, the cymbal has become a hat.

characters.name: Oona
lines: I was dreaming of a smaller moon. This one fits.
Miri plays the soft songs when my eyes get heavy.
Would you hold a little wish while I have a nap?

characters.name: Bibi
lines: I made a kite for the current. It wrote back with a dance.
You do not need a sky to have an up.
Thimble says the string is how a kite remembers home.

characters.name: Grandmother Thimble
lines: Look closely, little mermaid. The sea has stars too.
Bibi is testing whether wishes need a tail.
I have mapped the way home. It looks rather like a hug.
